title: polish(nav): smooth sidebar hover/active color transitions (Linear motion)
body:
## What

The sidebar nav buttons snapped their hover/active **background and text color** instantly, because those properties weren't in the transition list:

- `SidebarMenuButton` only animated `transition-[width,height,padding]` (needed for the icon-collapse), so hover/active background changed abruptly.
- `SidebarMenuSubButton` had **no** transition at all.

## Fix

- `SidebarMenuButton`: `transition-[width,height,padding]` → `transition-[width,height,padding,color,background-color]` (keeps the collapse animation, adds smooth color fade).
- `SidebarMenuSubButton`: add `transition-colors`.

Now nav hover and the active-item highlight fade in at the default **150ms** — the Linear-style motion the rest of the app already uses (table rows, metric tiles, kanban cards all `transition-colors`). This completes the motion pass.

## Verification

- Leaf nav button computes `transition-property: width, height, padding, color, background-color` at `0.15s` (checked via `getComputedStyle`). ✅
- No console errors; CSS-only change, affects desktop + mobile uniformly. ✅
